mapper.sql: id, dept_name AS name, parent_id AS parentId, enabled, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dept ORDER BY id LIMIT 1001
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dept(dept_name, parent_id, enabled) VALUES (#{entity.name}, #{entity.parentId}, #{entity.enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dept SET dept_name = #{entity.name}, parent_id = #{entity.parentId}, enabled = #{entity.enabled}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{entity.id} AND version = #{entity.version}
